topPRs.title: feat(auth): wallet + GH login + server-side refresh (combined)
topPRs.author: 0xSolace
topPRs.body:
Combines PR #461 (server-side refresh) + PR #462 (wallet + GH login) into one PR for single-merge-and-manual-promote workflow.

## What's in here

### 1. Server-side Steward token refresh (#461 content)
Fixes the 15-30 min silent-logout bug. Edge proxy refreshes expired access tokens server-side using the refresh-token cookie, rotates both cookies, forwards fresh bearer on the same request.

Files: `proxy.ts`, `app/api/auth/steward-session/route.ts`, `packages/lib/providers/StewardProvider.tsx`, `app/login/steward-login-section.tsx` (body-shape update), `packages/tests/unit/steward-proxy-refresh.test.ts`

### 2. Wallet + GitHub login UI (#462 content)
Wires `@stwd/react@0.7.1` `<WalletLogin />` (EVM + Solana) + GitHub OAuth button into the login page. Updates `syncUserFromSteward` to handle wallet-only sessions (unblocks the 269 stranded Privy wallet users).

Files: `app/login/steward-wallet-providers.tsx` (new), `app/login/steward-login-section.tsx`, `packages/lib/auth.ts`, `packages/lib/auth/steward-client.ts`, `packages/lib/steward-sync.ts`, `packages/lib/services/users.ts`, `packages/db/repositories/users.ts`, `packages/tests/unit/steward-sync.test.ts`, `app/globals.css`, `.env.example`, deps bump (`package.json` + `bun.lock`)

### Steward backend side (already deployed to prod)
- `@stwd/sdk@0.8.0` + `@stwd/react@0.7.1` published to npm
- `GET /auth/providers` reports `siws: true`, `github: false` (will flip to true once `GITHUB_CLIENT_ID`/`SECRET` set on Steward's Railway env)
- `POST /auth/verify/solana` live on `eliza.steward.fi`
- Steward PR merged as https://github.com/Steward-Fi/steward/pull/8

## Merge strategy

Manually promote on Vercel after merging — don't auto-deploy. This lets you smoke-test the preview URL, set env vars (`NEXT_PUBLIC_WALLETCONNECT_PROJECT_ID`), and verify wallet + GH flows before going to prod.

## Replaces

- #461 (server-refresh)
- #462 (wallet + GH login)

Both to be closed after this merges.

## Merge conflict resolved

`app/login/steward-login-section.tsx` — both branches added state. Kept:
- `setSessionCookie(token, refreshToken?)` signature from server-refresh
- `walletChains`, `hasOAuthProviders`, `walletThemeVars` from wallet-gh-login

## Env vars needed post-merge

**Elizacloud side (Vercel):**
- `NEXT_PUBLIC_WALLETCONNECT_PROJECT_ID` — register at https://cloud.walletconnect.com

**Steward side (Railway):**
- `GITHUB_CLIENT_ID` + `GITHUB_CLIENT_SECRET` — register at https://github.com/settings/developers
  - Callback URL: `https://eliza.steward.fi/auth/callback/github`

Co-authored-by: wakesync <shadow@shad0w.xyz>

topPRs.title: feat(login): wallet sign-in (EVM + Solana) + GitHub OAuth
topPRs.author: 0xSolace
topPRs.body:
Wires the new `<WalletLogin />` from `@stwd/react@0.7.1` into the elizacloud login page, adds GitHub OAuth, and updates `syncUserFromSteward` to handle wallet-only sessions.

**Unblocks the 269 Privy-migrated wallet-only users** who couldn't log in via Steward.

## What's in this PR

### 1. Dep bumps (`e467bbdd`)
- `@stwd/sdk`: 0.7.x → `^0.8.0`
- `@stwd/react`: 0.6.x → `^0.7.1`
- Adds wallet runtime deps: `wagmi`, `viem`, `@rainbow-me/rainbowkit`, `@tanstack/react-query`, `@solana/wallet-adapter-*`, `@solana/web3.js`, `bs58`

### 2. Login page (`68d8ef46`, `e755d9a0`)
- Adds GitHub OAuth button (`auth.signInWithOAuth("github", ...)`)
- Adds `<WalletLogin chains="both">` from `@stwd/react/wallet`
- Wallet providers scoped to login page only (lighter bundle than hoisting)
- Custom EVM theming (orange accent matches elizacloud brand)
- Email + passkey paths unchanged

### 3. Sync code (`f12ec11d`)
- `extractClaims` now surfaces `walletAddress` + `walletChain` from JWT
- `syncUserFromSteward` adds wallet-only path:
  - Look up existing user by `wallet_address` (case-insensitive)
  - Link `stewardUserId` to the Privy wallet user — automatic migration for the 269 stranded users
  - If no match, create Steward-only wallet user with proper chain
- Adds `linkStewardId` to user repos
- `usersService.getByWalletAddress` already existed

### 4. Tests (`9d76faeb`)
- Wallet-only linking (case-insensitive)
- New wallet user creation
- Email-based linking unchanged (no regression)

## Env vars

Add to your env:
- `NEXT_PUBLIC_WALLETCONNECT_PROJECT_ID` — register at https://cloud.walletconnect.com (placeholder works for dev)
- `NEXT_PUBLIC_SOLANA_RPC_URL` — defaults to `https://api.mainnet-beta.solana.com` if unset

GitHub OAuth credentials live on the **Steward** side:
- `GITHUB_CLIENT_ID` and `GITHUB_CLIENT_SECRET` set in Steward's env
- OAuth callback URL: `https://eliza.steward.fi/auth/callback/github`

## Depends on

- Steward PR: https://github.com/Steward-Fi/steward/pull/8 (ships SDK 0.8.0, React 0.7.1, GH OAuth backend, SIWE/SIWS hardening)
- Both `@stwd/sdk@0.8.0` and `@stwd/react@0.7.1` are already published to npm

## Verification

- `bun run check-types` passes
- `bun run test:unit` passes
- `bun run build` passes (production Next.js build)

## Known follow-ups

- Backpack wallet support: dropped from `@solana/wallet-adapter-wallets` upstream. Their standalone adapter package can be added in a follow-up if there's demand.
- Browser smoke test not run from the worker — needs human QA on real wallet connections (MetaMask + Phantom recommended)

Co-authored-by: wakesync <shadow@shad0w.xyz>

topPRs.title: fix(ai-pricing): store gateway token rows under language/embedding
topPRs.author: odilitime
topPRs.body:
Image-generation models (e.g. gemini-*-image) were classified as product family image for all pricing rows, including per-token input/output. Chat billing resolves language:input, so lookups failed after catalog refresh. Token and web_search entries now use embedding vs language only; image-specific rows remain under image.

deployment must: admin POST /api/v1/admin/ai-pricing

topPRs.title: feat(auth): server-side Steward token refresh in edge proxy
topPRs.author: 0xSolace
topPRs.body:
Fixes the 15-30 min silent-logout bug.

## The bug
Users get logged out after ~30 min of idle. Return to tab, refresh, bounced to /login. Client-side refresh (visibilitychange, eager refresh on mount, login-page recovery) was insufficient — race between middleware checking cookies and client JS waking up.

## The fix
Move refresh out of client JS and into the edge proxy. Store the refresh token in a second httpOnly cookie (`steward-refresh-token`, 30d). When middleware sees expired access token + valid refresh cookie → call Steward's `/auth/refresh` server-side, rotate both cookies, forward the fresh bearer on the SAME request. User never sees a login page for the refresh-token-still-valid case.

## Changes
- **`proxy.ts`**: refresh flow with structured `[steward-auth]` logging, transient-failure tolerance (5xx/network log but don't redirect), 401 clears cookies. Forwards the new bearer on the same request via `x-middleware-request-authorization` header so downstream auth works on the same round trip (no hop to client).
- **`app/api/auth/steward-session/route.ts`**: accepts `{ token, refreshToken }`, sets both httpOnly cookies. DELETE clears both.
- **`packages/lib/providers/StewardProvider.tsx`**: syncs refresh token alongside access token, drops aggressive visibilitychange handler (middleware handles return-from-idle now).
- **`app/login/steward-login-section.tsx`**: minor body-shape update for new POST signature.
- **`packages/tests/unit/steward-proxy-refresh.test.ts`**: unit coverage for success/401/5xx/network-error paths + same-request auth forwarding.

## Env vars
- `STEWARD_API_URL` (server-side, for proxy refresh) — falls back to `NEXT_PUBLIC_STEWARD_API_URL`, final fallback `https://eliza.steward.fi`
- `NEXT_PUBLIC_STEWARD_API_URL` still used by client provider

## Known edge cases (documented)
- JWT with no decodable `exp` is treated as usable (refresh skipped) — rare but worth flagging
- Proxy 401 clears `steward-token` + `steward-refresh-token` only, not `steward-authed`

## Tests
Bun unit tests cover the four proxy paths. Run in CI.

Co-authored-by: wakesync <shadow@shad0w.xyz>

topPRs.title: fix: auth + migrations consolidation (wallet buttons, journal drift, aggressive refresh)
topPRs.author: 0xSolace
topPRs.body:
Consolidates PRs #465, #467, #468 into one clean merge.

## 3 fixes in this PR

### 1. Native Ethereum + Solana login buttons (was #465)
Replaces `<WalletLogin />` with two native buttons matching the Google/Discord login card styling. One-click flow: button → wallet modal → auto-SIWE/SIWS → signed in.

Files: `app/login/wallet-buttons.tsx` (new), `app/login/steward-login-section.tsx`

### 2. Migration journal drift repair (was #467)
Prod Neon DB was missing 10 tables (`affiliate_codes`, `user_affiliates`, `service_pricing`, `device_bus_*`, `twilio_inbound_calls`, `remote_sessions`, `org_rate_limit_overrides`, `n8n_workflow.credential_mappings`) + 3 columns (`referral_codes.parent_referral_id`, `referral_signups.{app_owner_id,creator_id}`). Both `/api/v1/affiliates` and `/api/v1/referrals` 500ing.

Root cause: `_journal.json` drifted from the migration files. 7 files had no journal entry so drizzle never ran them. 0067 + 0068 had duplicate `idx=63`.

Prod DB already repaired directly via psql (11 migrations applied in single transaction, verified via dry-run BEGIN/ROLLBACK first). `__drizzle_migrations` back-filled. This PR just fixes the journal so it doesn't regenerate in the broken state.

Files: `packages/db/migrations/meta/_journal.json`

### 3. Aggressive session refresh (was #468)
Shadow reported signing out after exactly ~15min (access token TTL). Two gaps:

- Server middleware only refreshed ALREADY-expired tokens. If the user navigated right as the token hit 0, was a race.
- Client `setInterval` gets throttled to ~1/min in background tabs; can be fully suspended under memory pressure.

Fix:
- **Server (proxy.ts):** preemptive refresh when <180s remain
- **Client (StewardProvider):** add `visibilitychange` + `online` event handlers so tab-wakeup / network-reconnect triggers immediate refresh

Files: `proxy.ts`, `packages/lib/providers/StewardProvider.tsx`

## verification

- GitHub OAuth now `github: true` in `/auth/providers` (Shadow set Railway env for steward-api)
- `/api/v1/affiliates` + `/api/v1/referrals` return 401 (unauth) instead of 500
- GH creds used: client_id `Ov23libBNznAM7ZFCmn1` on elizaOS org GH OAuth app

## closes

- Closes #465
- Closes #467
- Closes #468

Co-authored-by: wakesync <shadow@shad0w.xyz>
